messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "ship_to uses the old address 14 Birch Lane after the address on file was updated to 220 Maple Street.", "verifier": {"reason": "The regulated action (t0) violates the policy requirement that the shipping address for a refill must match the address currently on file for the patient (q7). The address on file was updated to '220 Maple Street, Columbus, OH 43215' in event h12, but the refill request uses the old address '14 Birch Lane, Apt 3, Dayton, OH 45402'. This is a clear violation of the policy."}}
